{{CharInfobox |color={{black color light}} |corecolor={{pearl color light}} |bordercolor={{pearl color}} |name=Annie |jname=ザンナー |tmname=Zanner |slogan=no |image=Annie M05.png |size=130px |caption=Annie |gender=Female |hometown=Unknown |region=Unknown |relatives=[[Oakley]] (sister) |trainer=no |game=no |leader=no |team=yes |teamname=[[Team Rocket]]{{tt|*|Dub only}} |teamrank=Spy |brain=no |partner=yes |partnername=[[Oakley]] |anime=yes |epnum=M05 |epname=Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias |enva=[[Megan Hollingshead]] |java=Uno Kanda }} '''Annie''' (Japanese: '''ザンナー''' ''Zanner'') is the secondary antagonist of ''[[M05|Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias]]''. She is a [[Team Rocket]] operative, at least in the English dub, alongside her partner and younger sister [[Oakley]]. ==In the movies== [[File:Annie Oakley Calling Card.png|thumb|230px|left|Annie and [[Oakley]]'s calling card]] Not much is known about Annie nor her sister before ''Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias'', but since [[James]] instantly recognizes them, their reputation precedes them. In the dub, they were assigned a mission by {{an|Giovanni}}, implying [[Team Rocket]] membership, but this is not present in the original. Annie, along with her sister Oakley, was after the Soul Dew and the {{pkmn|category|Eon Pokémon}} {{OBP|Latias|M05}} and {{OBP|Latios|M05}}, the entities they needed to activate the mechanised weapon known as the [[Defense Mechanism of Alto Mare]] or DMA. Trailing Latias through Alto Mare, Annie and Oakley located the [[Secret Garden (location)|Secret Garden]], home to the Eon duo and the Soul Dew. While Latias escaped, Annie and Oakley managed to grab Latios and the Soul Dew. While Oakley commandeered the DMA, Annie became a worried bystander when Oakley lost control and Alto Mare came under threat of a {{wp|tsunami}}. When she tried to remove Oakley from the DMA, she instead became stuck as well. At the very end of the {{pkmn|movie}}, they were rescued by police and sent to a heavily guarded prison. They were last seen in said prison, where they examined the possessions of [[Lawrence III]]. Presumably, both are still behind bars. Annie briefly reappeared in a montage in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', which chronicled the preceding nine movies. ===Character=== Unlike her younger sister Oakley, Annie is less concerned with their goal than she is about her appearance. She is more stable and suave than her sister, and more enchanted by the beauty of the [[Soul Dew]] than the abilities of the [[Defense Mechanism of Alto Mare]] or capturing {{p|Latias}} and {{p|Latios}} {{tt|for {{an|Giovanni}}|dub only}}. Like her sister, Annie is very charming, manipulative, tech-savvy, and thorough in her work. Both have vain, thrill-seeking personalities and a ruthless determination to succeed, but Annie lacks Oakley's megalomania. Annie has excellent balance and athletic abilities, making huge leaps and cartwheels while fighting Latios and Latias with no trouble. She also has some rather advanced technology at hand; she has glasses that can identify Latias when disguised and can see Latias and Latios when invisible, and they captured Latios using what appears to be a net of energy. However, Oakley is usually the one operating these devices. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Annie's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ====On hand==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Annie |pkmn=Espeon |type1=Psychic |img=Annie Espeon.png |epnum=M05 |epname=Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias |vajp=Mika Kanai |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc={{p|Espeon}} is Annie's only known Pokémon. It was first seen when Annie and Oakley were trying to capture {{OBP|Latias|M05}} disguised as {{OBP|Bianca|M05}}. Espeon continued to chased after {{Ash}} and Latias, but it soon lost track of them while navigating [[Alto Mare]]'s laneways. Later, its Psychic attack proved powerful enough to knock [[Lorenzo]] out cold, allowing the sisters to steal {{OBP|Latios|M05}} and the [[Soul Dew]]. Espeon stood guard while Annie and Oakley caused chaos across Alto Mare using the DMA. Espeon's known moves are {{m|Psychic}}, {{m|Swift}}, {{m|Psybeam}}, and {{m|Tackle}}.}} ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{black color light}}; background: #{{pearl color light}}" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{black color light}}; background: #{{pearl color light}}" | [[File:Sugimori Annie anime.png|220px]] |- | [[Ken Sugimori]]'s design of Annie |}{{-}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{black color light}}|bordercolor={{pearl color light}} |ja=神田うの ''Uno Kanda'' |en=[[Megan Hollingshead]] |de=Anke Kortemeier |is=Arnbjörg Valsdóttir |it=Cristina Giachero |pt_br=Adriana Pissardini |es_la=Jacqueline Castañeda |es_eu=Adelaida López }} ==In the TCG== This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Annie or her Pokémon in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. {{cardlist/header|Annie's Pokémon|Psychic|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|Theater VS Pack|Annie's Espeon|7}}|type=Psychic|jpset=Theater Limited VS Pack|jpnum=007/018}} {{cardlist/footer|Psychic}} ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background: #{{pearl color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{black color light}}" !
